verses.original: Τοῦ δὲ Ἰησοῦ γεννηθέντος ἐν Βηθλέεμ τῆς Ἰουδαίας ἐν ἡμέραις Ἡρῴδου τοῦ βασιλέως ἰδοὺ μάγοι ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν παρεγένοντο εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα
verses.transliteration: Tou de Iēsou gennēthentos en Bēthleem tēs Ioudaias en hēmerais Hērōdou tou basileōs idou magoi apo anatolōn paregenonto eis Hierosolyma
verses.literal: After Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea during the time of King Herod Magi from the east arrived in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: E, TENDO nascido Jesus em Belém de Judéia, no tempo do rei Herodes, eis que uns magos vieram do oriente a Jerusalém,

verses.original: λέγοντες Ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ τεχθεὶς βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων εἴδομεν γὰρ αὐτοῦ τὸν ἀστέρα ἐν τῇ ἀνατολῇ καὶ ἤλθομεν προσκυνῆσαι αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: legontes Pou estin ho techtheis basileus tōn Ioudaiōn eidomen gar autou ton astera en tē anatolē kai ēlthomen proskynēsai autō
verses.literal: asking Where is the One who has been born King of the Jews We saw His star in the east and have come to worship Him
verses.literalPt: Dizendo: Onde está aquele que é nascido rei dos judeus? porque vimos a sua estrela no oriente, e viemos a adorá-lo.

verses.original: Ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἡρῴδης ἐταράχθη καὶ πᾶσα Ἱεροσόλυμα μετ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Akousas de ho basileus Hērōdēs etarachthē kai pasa Hierosolyma met’ autou
verses.literal: When King Herod heard this he was disturbed and all Jerusalem with him
verses.literalPt: E o rei Herodes, ouvindo isto, perturbou-se, e toda Jerusalém com ele.

verses.original: καὶ συναγαγὼν πάντας τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ γραμματεῖς τοῦ λαοῦ ἐπυνθάνετο παρ’ αὐτῶν ποῦ ὁ Χριστὸς γεννᾶται
verses.transliteration: kai synagagōn pantas tous archiereis kai grammateis tou laou epynthaneto par’ autōn pou ho Christos gennatai
verses.literal: And when he had assembled all the chief priests and scribes of the people he asked . . . them where the Christ was to be born
verses.literalPt: E, congregados todos os príncipes dos sacerdotes, e os escribas do povo, perguntou-lhes onde havia de nascer o Cristo.

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Ἐν Βηθλέεμ τῆς Ἰουδαίας οὕτως γὰρ γέγραπται διὰ τοῦ προφήτου
verses.transliteration: Hoi de eipan autō En Bēthleem tēs Ioudaias houtōs gar gegraptai dia tou prophētou
verses.literal: In Bethlehem in Judea - they replied . . . for this is what the prophet has written
verses.literalPt: E eles lhe disseram: Em Belém de Judéia; porque assim está escrito pelo profeta:

verses.original: Καὶ σύ Βηθλέεμ γῆ Ἰούδα οὐδαμῶς ἐλαχίστη εἶ ἐν τοῖς ἡγεμόσιν Ἰούδα ἐκ σοῦ γὰρ ἐξελεύσεται ἡγούμενος ὅστις ποιμανεῖ τὸν λαόν μου τὸν Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: Kai sy Bēthleem gē Iouda oudamōs elachistē ei en tois hēgemosin Iouda ek sou gar exeleusetai hēgoumenos hostis poimanei ton laon mou ton Israēl
verses.literal: But you Bethlehem in the land of Judah are by no means least among the rulers of Judah for out of you will come a ruler who will be the shepherd of My people Israel
verses.literalPt: E tu, Belém, terra de Judá, De modo nenhum és a menor entre as capitais de Judá; Porque de ti sairá o Guia Que há de apascentar o meu povo de Israel.

verses.original: Τότε Ἡρῴδης λάθρᾳ καλέσας τοὺς μάγους ἠκρίβωσεν παρ’ αὐτῶν τὸν χρόνον τοῦ φαινομένου ἀστέρος
verses.transliteration: Tote Hērōdēs lathra kalesas tous magous ēkribōsen par’ autōn ton chronon tou phainomenou asteros
verses.literal: Then Herod called the Magi secretly and learned from them the exact time the star had appeared
verses.literalPt: Então Herodes, chamando secretamente os magos, inquiriu exatamente deles acerca do tempo em que a estrela lhes aparecera.

verses.original: καὶ πέμψας αὐτοὺς εἰς Βηθλέεμ εἶπεν Πορευθέντες ἐξετάσατε ἀκριβῶς περὶ τοῦ παιδίου ἐπὰν δὲ εὕρητε ἀπαγγείλατέ μοι ὅπως κἀγὼ ἐλθὼν προσκυνήσω αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai pempsas autous eis Bēthleem eipen Poreuthentes exetasate akribōs peri tou paidiou epan de heurēte apangeilate moi hopōs kagō elthōn proskynēsō autō
verses.literal: And sending them to Bethlehem he said Go and search carefully for the Child and when you find Him report to me so that I too may go and worship Him
verses.literalPt: E, enviando-os a Belém, disse: Ide, e perguntai diligentemente pelo menino e, quando o achardes, participai-mo, para que também eu vá e o adore.

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ ἀκούσαντες τοῦ βασιλέως ἐπορεύθησαν καὶ ἰδοὺ ὁ ἀστὴρ ὃν εἶδον ἐν τῇ ἀνατολῇ προῆγεν αὐτούς ἕως ἐλθὼν ἐστάθη ἐπάνω οὗ ἦν τὸ παιδίον
verses.transliteration: Hoi de akousantes tou basileōs eporeuthēsan kai idou ho astēr hon eidon en tē anatolē proēgen autous heōs elthōn estathē epanō hou ēn to paidion
verses.literal: After they had heard the king they went on their way and the star they had seen in the east went ahead of them until it stood over the place where the Child was
verses.literalPt: E, tendo eles ouvido o rei, partiram; e eis que a estrela, que tinham visto no oriente, ia adiante deles, até que, chegando, se deteve sobre o lugar onde estava o menino.

verses.original: ἰδόντες δὲ τὸν ἀστέρα ἐχάρησαν χαρὰν μεγάλην σφόδρα
verses.transliteration: idontes de ton astera echarēsan charan megalēn sphodra
verses.literal: When they saw the star they rejoiced with great delight
verses.literalPt: E, vendo eles a estrela, regozijaram-se muito com grande alegria.

verses.original: καὶ ἐλθόντες εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν εἶδον τὸ παιδίον μετὰ Μαρίας τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ πεσόντες προσεκύνησαν αὐτῷ καὶ ἀνοίξαντες τοὺς θησαυροὺς αὐτῶν προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ δῶρα χρυσὸν καὶ λίβανον καὶ σμύρναν
verses.transliteration: kai elthontes eis tēn oikian eidon to paidion meta Marias tēs mētros autou kai pesontes prosekynēsan autō kai anoixantes tous thēsaurous autōn prosēnenkan autō dōra chryson kai libanon kai smyrnan
verses.literal: On coming to the house they saw the Child with His mother Mary and they fell down and worshiped Him Then they opened their treasures and presented Him with gifts of gold and frankincense and myrrh
verses.literalPt: E, entrando na casa, acharam o menino com Maria sua mãe e, prostrando-se, o adoraram; e abrindo os seus tesouros, ofertaram-lhe dádivas: ouro, incenso e mirra.

verses.original: Καὶ χρηματισθέντες κατ’ ὄναρ μὴ ἀνακάμψαι πρὸς Ἡρῴδην δι’ ἄλλης ὁδοῦ ἀνεχώρησαν εἰς τὴν χώραν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai chrēmatisthentes kat’ onar mē anakampsai pros Hērōdēn di’ allēs hodou anechōrēsan eis tēn chōran autōn
verses.literal: And having been warned in a dream not to return to Herod they withdrew to their country by another route
verses.literalPt: E, sendo por divina revelação avisados em sonhos para que não voltassem para junto de Herodes, partiram para a sua terra por outro caminho.

verses.original: Ἀναχωρησάντων δὲ αὐτῶν ἰδοὺ ἄγγελος κυρίου φαίνεται κατ’ ὄναρ τῷ Ἰωσὴφ λέγων Ἐγερθεὶς παράλαβε τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ φεῦγε εἰς Αἴγυπτον καὶ ἴσθι ἐκεῖ ἕως ἂν εἴπω σοι μέλλει γὰρ Ἡρῴδης ζητεῖν τὸ παιδίον τοῦ ἀπολέσαι αὐτό
verses.transliteration: Anachōrēsantōn de autōn idou angelos kyriou phainetai kat’ onar tō Iōsēph legōn Egertheis paralabe to paidion kai tēn mētera autou kai pheuge eis Aigypton kai isthi ekei heōs an eipō soi mellei gar Hērōdēs zētein to paidion tou apolesai auto
verses.literal: When the Magi had gone an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream Get up he said Take the Child and His mother and flee to Egypt Stay there until I tell you for Herod is going to search for the Child to kill Him
verses.literalPt: E, tendo eles se retirado, eis que o anjo do Senhor apareceu a José em sonhos, dizendo: Levanta-te, e toma o menino e sua mãe, e foge para o Egito, e demora-te lá até que eu te diga; porque Herodes há de procurar o menino para o matar.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἐγερθεὶς παρέλαβεν τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ νυκτὸς καὶ ἀνεχώρησεν εἰς Αἴγυπτον
verses.transliteration: Ho de egertheis parelaben to paidion kai tēn mētera autou nyktos kai anechōrēsen eis Aigypton
verses.literal: So he got up took the Child and His mother by night and withdrew to Egypt
verses.literalPt: E, levantando-se ele, tomou o menino e sua mãe, de noite, e foi para o Egito.

verses.original: καὶ ἦν ἐκεῖ ἕως τῆς τελευτῆς Ἡρῴδου ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν ὑπὸ κυρίου διὰ τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος Ἐξ Αἰγύπτου ἐκάλεσα τὸν υἱόν μου
verses.transliteration: kai ēn ekei heōs tēs teleutēs Hērōdou hina plērōthē to rhēthen hypo kyriou dia tou prophētou legontos Ex Aigyptou ekalesa ton huion mou
verses.literal: where he stayed until the death of Herod This fulfilled what the Lord had spoken through the prophet Out of Egypt I called My Son
verses.literalPt: E esteve lá, até à morte de Herodes, para que se cumprisse o que foi dito da parte do Senhor pelo profeta, que diz: Do Egito chamei o meu Filho.

verses.original: Τότε Ἡρῴδης ἰδὼν ὅτι ἐνεπαίχθη ὑπὸ τῶν μάγων ἐθυμώθη λίαν καὶ ἀποστείλας ἀνεῖλεν πάντας τοὺς παῖδας τοὺς ἐν Βηθλέεμ καὶ ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ὁρίοις αὐτῆς ἀπὸ διετοῦς καὶ κατωτέρω κατὰ τὸν χρόνον ὃν ἠκρίβωσεν παρὰ τῶν μάγων
verses.transliteration: Tote Hērōdēs idōn hoti enepaichthē hypo tōn magōn ethymōthē lian kai aposteilas aneilen pantas tous paidas tous en Bēthleem kai en pasi tois horiois autēs apo dietous kai katōterō kata ton chronon hon ēkribōsen para tōn magōn
verses.literal: When Herod saw that he had been outwitted by the Magi he was filled with rage Sending orders he put to death all the boys in Bethlehem and . . . . . . its vicinity who were two years old and under according to the time he had learned from the Magi
verses.literalPt: Então Herodes, vendo que tinha sido iludido pelos magos, irritou-se muito, e mandou matar todos os meninos que havia em Belém, e em todos os seus contornos, de dois anos para baixo, segundo o tempo que diligentemente inquirira dos magos.

verses.original: τότε ἐπληρώθη τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Ἰερεμίου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος
verses.transliteration: tote eplērōthē to rhēthen dia Ieremiou tou prophētou legontos
verses.literal: Then what was spoken through the prophet Jeremiah was fulfilled
verses.literalPt: Então se cumpriu o que foi dito pelo profeta Jeremias, que diz:

verses.original: Φωνὴ ἐν Ῥαμὰ ἠκούσθη κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὀδυρμὸς πολύς Ῥαχὴλ κλαίουσα τὰ τέκνα αὐτῆς καὶ οὐκ ἤθελεν παρακληθῆναι ὅτι οὐκ εἰσίν
verses.transliteration: Phōnē en Rhama ēkousthē klauthmos kai odyrmos polys Rhachēl klaiousa ta tekna autēs kai ouk ēthelen paraklēthēnai hoti ouk eisin
verses.literal: A voice is heard in Ramah weeping and great mourning Rachel weeping for her children and refusing . . . to be comforted because they are no more
verses.literalPt: Em Ramá se ouviu uma voz, Lamentação, choro e grande pranto: Raquel chorando os seus filhos, E não querendo ser consolada, porque já não existem.

verses.original: Τελευτήσαντος δὲ τοῦ Ἡρῴδου ἰδοὺ ἄγγελος Κυρίου φαίνεται κατ’ ὄναρ τῷ Ἰωσὴφ ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ
verses.transliteration: Teleutēsantos de tou Hērōdou idou angelos Kyriou phainetai kat’ onar tō Iōsēph en Aigyptō
verses.literal: After Herod died an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt
verses.literalPt: Morto, porém, Herodes, eis que o anjo do Senhor apareceu num sonho a José no Egito,

verses.original: λέγων Ἐγερθεὶς παράλαβε τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ πορεύου εἰς γῆν Ἰσραήλ τεθνήκασιν γὰρ οἱ ζητοῦντες τὴν ψυχὴν τοῦ παιδίου
verses.transliteration: legōn Egertheis paralabe to paidion kai tēn mētera autou kai poreuou eis gēn Israēl tethnēkasin gar hoi zētountes tēn psychēn tou paidiou
verses.literal: Get up he said Take the Child and His mother and go to the land of Israel for those seeking the Child’s life are now dead
verses.literalPt: Dizendo: Levanta-te, e toma o menino e sua mãe, e vai para a terra de Israel; porque já estão mortos os que procuravam a morte do menino.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἐγερθεὶς παρέλαβεν τὸ παιδίον καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς γῆν Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: Ho de egertheis parelaben to paidion kai tēn mētera autou kai eisēlthen eis gēn Israēl
verses.literal: So Joseph got up took the Child and His mother and went to the land of Israel
verses.literalPt: Então ele se levantou, e tomou o menino e sua mãe, e foi para a terra de Israel.

verses.original: ἀκούσας δὲ ὅτι Ἀρχέλαος βασιλεύει τῆς Ἰουδαίας ἀντὶ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ Ἡρῴδου ἐφοβήθη ἐκεῖ ἀπελθεῖν χρηματισθεὶς δὲ κατ’ ὄναρ ἀνεχώρησεν εἰς τὰ μέρη τῆς Γαλιλαίας
verses.transliteration: akousas de hoti Archelaos basileuei tēs Ioudaias anti tou patros autou Hērōdou ephobēthē ekei apelthein chrēmatistheis de kat’ onar anechōrēsen eis ta merē tēs Galilaias
verses.literal: But when he learned that Archelaus was reigning in Judea in place of his father Herod he was afraid to go there And having been warned in a dream he withdrew to the district of Galilee
verses.literalPt: E, ouvindo que Arquelau reinava na Judéia em lugar de Herodes, seu pai, receou ir para lá; mas avisado em sonhos, por divina revelação, foi para as partes da Galiléia.

verses.original: καὶ ἐλθὼν κατῴκησεν εἰς πόλιν λεγομένην Ναζαρέτ ὅπως πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ τῶν προφητῶν ὅτι Ναζωραῖος κληθήσεται
verses.transliteration: kai elthōn katōkēsen eis polin legomenēn Nazaret hopōs plērōthē to rhēthen dia tōn prophētōn hoti Nazōraios klēthēsetai
verses.literal: and he went and lived in a town called Nazareth So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophets He will be called a Nazarene
verses.literalPt: E chegou, e habitou numa cidade chamada Nazaré, para que se cumprisse o que fora dito pelos profetas: Ele será chamado Nazareno.
